neutral.EN: It's down... but there are more.
neutral.TL: Patay na... pero may iba pa.

neutral.EN: You got it... God, look around us.
neutral.TL: Nakuha mo... Diyos ko, tingnan mo ang paligid.

neutral.EN: Dead... but I hear more shuffling.
neutral.TL: Patay na... pero may naririnig pa akong kaluskos.

neutral.EN: That one's down... don't let others flank.
neutral.TL: Bagsak na ang isang 'yon... huwag hayaang may pumaligid.

neutral.EN: It's over for that one... but we're not safe.
neutral.TL: Tapos na ang isa... pero hindi pa tayo ligtas.

neutral.EN: You killed it... please tell me that's the last one.
neutral.TL: Napatay mo... pakiusap sabihin mong huli na 'yan.

neutral.EN: One is down... but more could come.
neutral.TL: Isang bagsak... pero baka may dumating pa.

neutral.EN: Good, it's dead... just watch the darkness.
neutral.TL: Mabuti at patay na... mag-ingat lang sa dilim.

neutral.EN: Down... but my heart won't stop racing.
neutral.TL: Bagsak... pero ayaw humupa ng kaba ko.

neutral.EN: You stopped it... but we have to keep checking.
neutral.TL: Napigilan mo... pero kailangan nating patuloy na magmasid.

neutral.EN: Good. Just—keep watching them.
neutral.TL: Ayos. Basta—bantayan mo sila.

neutral.EN: Nice hit... just don't let them get close.
neutral.TL: Magandang tama... huwag mo lang silang palapitin.

neutral.EN: You killed it... keep your eyes on the shadows.
neutral.TL: Napatay mo... bantayan mo ang mga anino.

neutral.EN: It's dead... just watch out for more.
neutral.TL: Patay na... mag-ingat lang sa iba pa.

neutral.EN: Okay, that one's gone... please stay watchful.
neutral.TL: Sige, wala na 'yon... pakiusap magmatyag ka.

neutral.EN: Good swing... don't turn your back on them.
neutral.TL: Magandang hataw... huwag mo silang tatalikuran.

neutral.EN: It's on the floor... keep watching every door.
neutral.TL: Nasa sahig na... bantayan ang bawat pinto.

neutral.EN: Down... just keep looking everywhere.
neutral.TL: Bagsak... tumingin ka lang sa lahat ng sulok.

neutral.EN: You dropped it... God, please be careful.
neutral.TL: Ibinagsak mo... Diyos ko, mag-ingat ka.

neutral.EN: Handled... just don't let your guard down.
neutral.TL: Naasikaso... huwag mo lang ibaba ang depensa.

neutral.EN: Okay. One less. I still don't like this.
neutral.TL: Sige. Isa na lang ang nabawas. Ayoko pa rin nito.

neutral.EN: One down... this whole place creeps me out.
neutral.TL: Isang bagsak... kinikilabutan ako sa buong lugar na 'to.

neutral.EN: It's dead. I hate being surrounded like this.
neutral.TL: Patay na. Ayaw na ayaw kong napapalibutan tayo.

neutral.EN: One less threat... my knees are shaking.
neutral.TL: Bawas ang isang banta... nanginginig ang mga tuhod ko.

neutral.EN: Good, it stopped moving... I'm terrified.
neutral.TL: Mabuti at tumigil na sa paggalaw... natatakot ako.

neutral.EN: Down. I just want this nightmare to end.
neutral.TL: Bagsak. Gusto ko nang matapos ang bangungot na 'to.

neutral.EN: One less rotten thing... still scares me to death.
neutral.TL: Bawas ang isang bulok... takot na takot pa rin ako.

neutral.EN: It's gone. I really, really don't like this.
neutral.TL: Wala na. Ayoko talaga, ayoko sa ganito.

neutral.EN: Dead. Can we leave as soon as it's quiet?
neutral.TL: Patay na. Pwede ba tayong umalis kapag tumahimik na?

neutral.EN: You killed it... but my hands are ice cold.
neutral.TL: Napatay mo... pero parang yelo ang lamig ng mga kamay ko.
